disconnect_from_server: You have disconnected from the Era.
dialog_newcomer_welcome_body_info_line:
Before you join the server, you need to create an Era Account.
<#ebebeb>If you don't want to register, you can choose to disconnect from the server.
dialog_newcomer_welcome_button_disconnec: If you don't want to register, you will not be able to play on the server. This option will disconnect you from the server.
dialog_account_registration_body_info_li: Please fill out the registration form below.
dialog_account_registration_body_email_t: <#ff4800>We do not verify or check your email address. However, we strongly recommend providing an email address you can access, as it may be used to verify your identity if you ever need to recover your account.
dialog_account_registration_successful_b: Your account has been created! Enjoy your adventure!

Here are your recovery codes. Store them in a safe place. You can use these codes to recover your account if you forget your password.
<#eb3434>IMPORTANT: After closing this page, you will no longer be able to access these codes again!
